History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient has a 3-day history of headache.
Headache is located over the right eye.
Patient sees lights in front of the eyes during the headache.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Seeing lights in front of eyes.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Headache is worse when the patient stands up but not when bending over, coughing, or sneezing.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Can be worse when stands up not when bends over/cough/sneeze.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Headache intensity is rated between 5 and 8 out of 10.
Ibuprofen provides slight relief but does not resolve the headache.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Taking ibuprofen, eases slightly but not resolving.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient was well before this episode.
Patient reports lacking in energy but no weight loss.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Has been lacking in energy but no wt loss.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient has had previous generalized headaches which were mild and associated with altered vision.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Has had some generalised headaches before but not bad and associated symptoms/altered vision.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Current headache is worse in the light (photophobia).
Vision is not disturbed during the current episode.

Past_Medical_History.content: Patient reports no past medical history.

Medications.content: Patient is self-treating with ibuprofen for the headache.
Medications.source_text: Taking ibuprofen, eases slightly but not resolving.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient does not use illicit drugs.
Patient drinks about three beers per week.

Plan_of_Care.content: Arrange neurological examination to exclude other pathology.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: needs neurological examination to exclude other pathology.

Plan_of_Care.content: Prescribed an anti-inflammatory to be taken with food.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: prescribed anti-inflammatory to take with food (will prescribe).

Follow_up_Information.content: Patient instructed to contact the clinic immediately or attend A&E if the headache becomes severe or unrelenting.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: If gets worse in meantime contact us straightaway or go to A&E is severe/unrelenting.

Review_of_Systems.content: Patient reports no nausea or vomiting.
Patient reports no altered taste or smell.
Patient has not been woken up at night by the headache.
Review_of_Systems.source_text: Not woken up in the night.

Review_of_Systems.content: Patient reports no tingling, numbness, or weakness.
Patient reports vision is not disturbed.

Physical_Findings.content: Blood pressure checked one year ago was normal.
Physical_Findings.source_text: BP last checked 1 yr ago was normal.
